back: Communication through official channels and rules: letters, memos, reports, notices, minutes.
Unofficial communication among staff: conversations, rumours, casual messages.

front: Formal communication: one advantage, one disadvantage?
back: Advantage: accurate and recorded. Disadvantage: can be slow through long chains of command.
Advantage: fast, builds relationships. Disadvantage: spreads rumours and inaccurate information.
Letterhead, references, date, inside address, salutation, subject heading, body, complimentary close, signature and position.
"Dear Sir or Madam" → "Yours faithfully"; "Dear Mrs Dube" → "Yours sincerely".
A short written message inside an organisation, headed To, From, Date, Subject.
Email, instant messaging, video calls, social media, smartphones, cloud documents, websites and online chat.
Faster, cheaper, wider, easier records; but costs, dependence on power and networks, security risks and overload.
